# refs/

Reference images for DRISHTI. Not shipped — study material for craft review.

Drop your own captures here:

- `study-*.png` — screenshots of sites whose craft we're chasing (award-site 3D,
  editorial type scale, data-viz honesty). One per file, prefix `study-`.
- `packet-BEFORE.png` — the backend's rendered `packet.pdf`, so the on-screen
  PACKET view can be checked pixel-for-pixel against it (§9: must render identically).

Nothing here is loaded by the app.
